caci_worksheets.title: CACI – Eosinophilic Esophagitis

criteria.ame_must_review: Treating physician finds the individual is compliant with treatment, condition is well-controlled, and no medication side-effects.

Documentation of the most recent endoscopy with biopsy, performed within a timeframe consistent with the treating gastroenterologist’s recommended surveillance interval, shows: Evidence of histologic remission (less than 15 eos/hpf) and no evidence of fibrostenotic disease, (no esophageal rings, no strictures, and no narrow-caliber esophagus.)
NO history of food impaction: - In the last 12 months OR - While on treatment

Treated with one or more of the following: - Proton pump inhibitor - Topical or oral steroids that do not exceed 20 mg prednisone per day - dupilumab (Dupixent) (requires 4-hour post dose observation/no-fly)

block_60_options: Has current OR previous SI/AASI but now CACI qualified Eosinophilic Esophagitis.
